auto_provision.desc: When `true`, this method automatically creates new workspace accounts for the IDP group members.

team_ids.desc: A comma separated list of encoded team (workspace) IDs. Each workspace _MUST_ belong to the organization associated with the token.

desc: Associate one or more default workspaces with an organization-wide IDP group.

errors.auto_provision_failure: A failure occurred while assigning IDP group members to a specific workspace; see `errors` element for a list of failed team IDs.
errors.auto_provision_required: The IDP group requires a mandatory workspace link, so `auto_provision` must be `true`.
errors.invalid_team_ids: One or more team IDs provided were invalid; see the `errors` field in the response for the list of invalid team IDs.
errors.multi_workspace_restriction: The IDP group has members that cannot be linked to more than one workspace.
errors.restricted_action: The calling user cannot update the specified usergroup.
errors.team_limit_exceeded: The number of teams associated with the org group would exceed the limit.
errors.workspace_not_eligible: The workspace is not eligible to be linked to this IDP group; it is not on the org's allow-list of eligible workspaces.
